design.colorMode: light-only (navy chapters provide contrast; no dark theme)

colors.derived: gold-light, gold-deep, gold-hover, navy-bright, navy-ink, on-navy, border — color-mix of brand tokens only

typography.scale: H1 extrabold tight (42→72px), H2 extrabold (30→44px), eyebrow = uppercase 11px bold pill

patterns: glow = radial alpha mask (no filter: blur) for decorative colour glows
motion.reducedMotion: MotionConfig reducedMotion=user + motion-reduce:animate-none; counters show final value

preferredPrimitives: shadcn Button (brand variants gold/navy/outline-navy, sizes pill*)

must: Only brand tokens from globals.css — Tailwind default palette is removed; ESLint theme-lock rejects arbitrary/raw colours
shadcn primitives first; brand components compose them
RTL-safe logical utilities (ms/me/ps/pe/start/end); arrows flip with rtl:-scale-x-100
WCAG AA text contrast; ≥44px touch targets; visible gold focus ring
All copy through next-intl messages (en + ar)
avoid: Gold text for body copy on white (1.8:1)
Hand-rolled primitives when a shadcn one exists
Large filter: blur() glow layers (GPU stalls on low-memory devices) — use the `glow` utility

decisions.decision: Vibrant direction for the marketing site: alternating navy/light 'chapters', gradient meshes, glass cards, gold gradient text, scroll-reveal motion, animated counters and map route.
decisions.reason: Client feedback: the first build looked too minimal; wanted vibrant, modern and gorgeous within the fixed brand palette.
grounding: 21st: Glassmorphism Trust Hero, Milestone Timeline, World Map (aceternity)

decisions.decision: Section eyebrows are pills (navy text on gold tint on light backgrounds).
decisions.reason: Gold text on white fails WCAG AA.

decisions.decision: All remaining landing pages built in the same vibrant chapter system (Businesses, Global Presence, NEAMAT CARE, News + articles, Careers, Contact, Help, Support, Privacy, Terms); photos replaced with 1600–2400px originals.
decisions.reason: Client request: finish the other landing pages, modern/professional/vibrant, with good photo quality.
grounding: 21st: Contact Card, Tabbed FAQ Accordion, Job Listing

decisions.decision: Decorative glows use the `glow` utility (radial mask) instead of blur-[100px+] filters.
decisions.reason: Stacked 420px filter-blur layers froze Chrome's compositor during QA on an 8 GB machine.
